name: @r4-adapters/quote-http
description: R4-J3B Quote V2 HTTP adapter of the Quote V2 port (MS-pesaschile-quote-service OpenAPI 2.0.0): bearer auth, Idempotency-Key, deadline, response validation, typed owner errors, unknown-outcome classification for mutations, authenticated document read. Transport only: no pricing, no PDF rendering, no email. Outside R4 Core.
